name: Citizenship by Marriage to a Slovenian Citizen

requirements.blocker_text: Citizenship Act of the Republic of Slovenia: a person married to a Slovenian citizen may naturalize after just 1 year of uninterrupted actual residence in Slovenia, exempt from the standard 10-year residency requirement, provided the other general naturalization conditions (age, financial security/housing, no serious criminal record, no residence ban) are met.
requirements.fix_path: Marry a Slovenian citizen, establish 1 year of uninterrupted residence in Slovenia, and apply, meeting the other general naturalization conditions.

evidence_required.document: Proof of financial security and stable housing

sources.title: Uradni list Republike Slovenije (Official Gazette of the Republic of Slovenia) -- Zakon o drzavljanstvu Republike Slovenije (Citizenship Act), spousal naturalization provision

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Slovenia). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- hard requirement sourced directly to Slovenia's own Official Gazette, tier 1. GENUINE POSITIVE FINDING: a steep reduction from the standard 10-year residency requirement to just 1 year for a spouse of a Slovenian citizen -- among the most generous marriage-based naturalization timelines in this dataset. The source's language is gender-neutral ('a person married to a Slovenian citizen'), with no asymmetry found. dual_citizenship_allowed set true consistent with si_citizenship_by_descent.json and si_citizenship_naturalisation.json -- see the latter's notes for the disclosed tension between the Act's general dual-nationality permission and its separate renunciation condition.
